messages.text: Lopez takes Romero's WBA title to become three-weight champion

metadata.summary: Teofimo Lopez beat Rolly Romero in Las Vegas on Saturday night to capture the WBA welterweight title and become a three-division world champion.
metadata.content: Teofimo Lopez takes Rolly Romero's WBA welterweight title to become three-division world champion | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Teofimo Lopez takes Rolly Romero's WBA welterweight title to become three-division world champion Teofimo Lopez secures majority decision over Rolly Romero at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas; one judge scores bout 114-114, with other two having it 115-113 and 116-112 for Lopez; the current WBA mandatory challenger is Jack Catterall Sunday 23 August 2026 10:21, UK Image: Teofimo Lopez celebrates his win over Rolly Romero to claim the WBA welterwight title Teofimo Lopez beat Rolly Romero in Las Vegas on Saturday night to capture the WBA welterweight title and become a three-division world champion. In his welterweight debut, Lopez secured a majority decision over his friend and sparring partner at the T-Mobile Arena. One judge scored the bout 114-114, while the other two had it 115-113 and 116-112 for Lopez. It was an impressive return to form from Lopez after his loss to Shakur Stevenson in their WBO super lightweight title fight in January. metadata.summary: Manchester City have agreed a deal with Lille for Morocco international midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi worth up to £86m (€100m).
metadata.content: Ayyoub Bouaddi transfer: Manchester City reach agreement with Lille to sign 18-year-old Morocco midfielder | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Ayyoub Bouaddi transfer: Manchester City reach agreement with Lille to sign 18-year-old Morocco midfielder Manchester City's deal to sign Ayyoub Bouaddi is worth £86m; Man City are paying a fixed fee of £81.3m plus £4.3m in add-ons; City are working to rebuild their midfield after the departures of Rodri, Bernardo Silva and Tijjani Reijnders Sunday 23 August 2026 14:14, UK Image: Man City have agreed a record-breaking fee to sign Ayyoub Bouaddi Manchester City have agreed a deal with Lille for Morocco international midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi worth up to £86m (€100m). City are paying a fixed fee of £81.3m plus £4.3m in add-ons. The 18-year-old is set to become the most expensive teenage signing in Premier League history, surpassing the £58.9m Manchester United committed to paying Lille for Leny Yoro in 2024. metadata.content: Tyson Fury can't pull out of Anthony Joshua fight despite his 'shouting and screaming', says Eddie Hearn | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Tyson Fury can't pull out of Anthony Joshua fight despite his 'shouting and screaming', says Eddie Hearn Tyson Fury had cast doubts over the Anthony Joshua fight after claiming on social media his British rival has asked for "more money", labelling him and his team "cowards"; Fury and Joshua have been negotiating a long-awaited heavyweight clash for a proposed date in November Sunday 23 August 2026 11:02, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Tyson Fury doesn't hold back as he lashes out at Anthony Joshua as the wait goes on for the pair to confirm a much-anticipated showdown. Credit: @tysonfury. Eddie Hearn has said that "no-one can pull out" of the long-awaited heavyweight clash between Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua. Fury claimed on Friday that the proposed fight is in serious doubt after Joshua supposedly asked for "more money", labelling him and his team "cowards". But Hearn, who represents Joshua, is confident the fight will still go ahead. 'Keep on running!'
